scientific_integrity: Analytic proof with exact algebraic identity; symbolic/rational and floating-point checks supplement but do not replace proof. The original first-public date belongs to the motivating literature, not to this result. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only one-step Frobenius error comparison of the two reversed three-factor symmetric Strang products for two orthogonal rank-one dissipators; not a spectral norm, statewise, higher-rank or multi-step comparison. Independent historical priority is unresolved.
title: Faster-outside Strang ordering for two rank-one dissipative generators
